directions.grpo_anchor: terminal GRPO with fixed KL coefficient 0.1
directions.turn_rloo: per-turn active-peer RLOO with normalized geodesic progress weight 0.5, gamma 1.0
directions.srgpo: trajectory GRPO plus random cross-state process groups of 16, step weight 0.5

common.primary_gate: paired SR and SPL >= +2 percentage points vs matched FP16 SFT; turn-RLOO and SRGPO also each >= +2 pp vs GRPO anchor

limits: Development split has been used adaptively; exploratory only.
Configured seeds do not establish independent rollout RNG streams.
Simulator geodesic progress is privileged training-only signal, not semantic verifier.
No reserved split or val-unseen will be opened for tuning in this pilot.

primary_gate.any_scale_candidate: paired SR and SPL each >= +2 percentage points versus matched FP16 SFT on fixed development256; the GRPO anchor is judged against SFT only
primary_gate.algorithm_claim: turn_rloo and srgpo each must additionally improve paired SR and SPL by >= +2 pp versus grpo_anchor
primary_gate.scale: if a candidate clears both conditions, freeze it and run 3 configured seeds at same 512x128 n=4 budget; no tuning on reserved or val-unseen

revision_note: After isolated one-GPU smoke failed at both utilization 0.25 and 0.4 with no KV cache blocks, revised to the previously validated two-GPU trainer topology and utilization 0.6; original freeze is archived under runlogs/freeze/revision_one_gpu_failure_025_040/. This is a resource-topology correction, not a method or budget change. Three methods cannot be concurrent on this four-GPU host while reserving GPU2 for Habitat and using two GPUs per trainer; test sequentially unless runtime evidence supports otherwise. Gate wording clarifies GRPO anchor is compared to SFT only; RLOO/SRGPO also need +2pp on both metrics over GRPO. Three 64-step n=4 methods run sequentially by the frozen runner because the host has four GPUs, two are needed per trainer, and GPU2 hosts Habitat; orchestration stops on any failed marker.
